img_374.description: Blurred centre of a ringed diagram with stars. In the centre are two speckled grey fish lying one above the other, and a blue line curves round below them, linking them. One patch is masked.
img_374.central_figure: two fish tied together by a cord
img_374.sign_reason: two fish joined by a line

img_377.description: Blurred centre with figures holding blue and red tubs around the edge. Inside the inner circle is a pale, uncoloured four-legged animal with a long neck, a small head and perhaps short horns. A green plant or tree stands to its left and there is green ground beneath it.
img_377.central_figure: a pale four-legged animal (goat or ram-like) beside a green bush
img_377.sign_reason: slender horned quadruped with a tree, typical ram/goat iconography; horns unclear

img_981.description: Very faint and blurred. A four-legged animal outline with a few blue touches and one red dot sits in the centre circle. A large patch is masked below it.
img_981.sign_reason: a quadruped is visible, but horns and body shape are too faint to separate ram from bull

img_738.description: Faded centre with stars and figures. In the inner circle is a red creature with many legs and claws spread sideways. A greenish shape lies above it and there are red dots to the right. A patch is masked below.
img_738.central_figure: a red many-legged crustacean (crab or crayfish)

img_486.description: Faded centre. A small standing figure in a blue garment holds a long thin object pointed diagonally down and to the left. The lower part is masked.
img_486.central_figure: a standing person in blue holding a long weapon-like object
img_486.sign_reason: a figure holding what looks like a bow or crossbow; could also be a figure holding a plant

img_525.description: Faded centre with dense radiating lines. A balance with a central upright post at the top, a horizontal beam and a round pan hanging at each end. The middle is masked.
img_525.sign_reason: a beam balance with two hanging pans

img_507.description: Centre of a diagram with coloured figures around it. In the inner circle a reddish outlined quadruped with horns or antlers stands beside a green tuft or tree, with green ground below. A patch is masked.
img_507.central_figure: a reddish horned four-legged animal by a small tree
img_507.sign_reason: a heavier-bodied horned quadruped; could be a ram

img_651.description: In the inner circle a solid red-brown four-legged animal with a long neck and small upright horns, rearing slightly. A green tuft is at the left and green ground below. A patch is masked.
img_651.central_figure: a red goat- or ram-like animal by a green bush
img_651.sign_reason: slender horned quadruped with a tree, ram/goat posture

img_977.description: A green-grey lizard-like creature with a long tail curled upward, under a large eight-pointed star. A patch is masked beneath.
img_977.central_figure: a lizard or salamander-like creature with a curled tail
img_977.sign_reason: a reptile or scorpion-like body with a raised, curled tail

img_612.description: A ringed diagram with figures in compartments. In the centre is a green-shaded quadruped with a long neck and an upturned head, beside a dark green tree on the left and blue water or ground below. A patch is masked.
img_612.central_figure: a greenish four-legged animal (goat or ram-like) by a tree
img_612.sign_reason: a horned or long-necked quadruped with a tree; ram and bull are hard to separate

img_464.description: Faint centre. A figure wearing a blue cap stands holding something blue that spreads out like a fan or rays to the right. Their robe or legs reach down.
img_464.central_figure: a single person in a blue cap holding a fan- or bow-like object
img_464.sign_reason: a single human figure; the held object might be a crossbow (Sagittarius) or a plant/garment (Virgo), but it is unclear

img_200.description: Faint centre. Two standing human figures face each other holding hands: the left one in green with a green cap, the right one in blue.
img_200.sign_reason: a pair of human figures joined together

recognise_source: Yes: these look like the zodiac medallions of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), folios f70v-f73v.
